meta.Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪ Humhumhumm♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've been humming really loudly for a while now, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?
I'm not being that loud♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You seem more excited than usual today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'd say more giddy than excited...
You should stop since someone might think you're acting really suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
I am so not acting suspicious!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe.
But I do understand how you feel, Saki. I mean...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that so many people are listening to our debut song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...! Isn't it awesome?!
It just keeps getting more and more views! We're already up to 500,000!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is pretty awesome...
The Miku version even hit a million.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We really have her and the others to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really glad that the VIRTUAL SINGER version with Miku went viral... That led to a lot of people also giving the Leo/need version a listen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Miku helped get all these people to listen to our song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. And I couldn't be happier...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of a lot of people...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Just before you and Saki came over to our classroom earlier...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Phew... School's finally over...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It'll be our first time practicing in the studio in a while, so we need to do our best.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho and Saki just messaged to say that their homeroom is going to take a little while and that we should wait here in our classroom. They said they'll come over once it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, let's sit tight for a...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Umm... Are you two free right now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... Do you mean us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Aren't they in a different class...?
I wonder why they want to talk to us...)

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
You're Hoshino and Mochizuki, right...?
From Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, yes.
That's us...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Wow! I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Oh, we're sorry for asking out of the blue like this.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: But everyone in our class has been talking about your guys' song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
You made those Miku songs too, right?!
We were completely blown away!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah! That song's so good!
I'm totally a fan now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: I know! If possible, can we get your autographs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A-Autographs?!
Mine? But I don't...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
No autographs?!
Wait, what about a picture?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
I want their autographs too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, umm... Then, one at a time...!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Really?! Yes!
Then, can you sign this for me first...?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: No, we should take a picture first!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair!!!
I wish somebody would've asked us too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You do? Well, I guess we should be thankful that our fan base is growing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
It is a little strange knowing that others at our school are listening to our music, but I'm happy about it overall...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so great to hear that our music and Miku's singing are reaching all these people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, we should tell Miku and the others how so many different people are listening to our song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! And we gotta thank them!
I mean, we wouldn't have been able to get this far without them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
I doubt we would've been able to complete that song without their help. More to the point, Leo/need wouldn't be where it's at today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this might be a good time for us to thank them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's all head over later and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Look over there...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's us on the digital billboard...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-This is so cool...!
That's us up there, front and center...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It really feels like we're pros now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They told us that we'd be appearing up there, but I'm still surprised nonetheless...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, this is kinda weird...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not too long ago, becoming professional musicians seemed so impossible. But one thing led to another, and now we're here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't you think it's a bit early to start reminiscing...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that we are pros, we need to find ways to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, that means we gotta start working even harder than ever before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo did say that it's important for us to keep improving the level of our performances.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, we have that festival coming up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...!
We need to do our best to not let everyone else hog the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's keep doing everything we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line:
Really?!
That's so cool☆ I didn't know you guys also did that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We were all so excited!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you two seem to be having a fun conversation. Mind if I asked what it's about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Sakki was just telling me about how they recorded their debut song♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How they recorded it?
That sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you mind telling me as well?
What was that experience like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we got to play at this recording studio Solis Records uses a lot...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we normally don't have all those engineers and stuff around, so we got really nervous!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I liked the thing you said about how songs can be recorded in two different ways. That was really interesting♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Two different ways?
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you mean having everyone record separately versus recording the entire band playing together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We really didn't know which to choose at first...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What did you land on?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We decided to play together!
That's just how we're used to doing things, and it seemed more fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree that playing together suits your band better.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, how did your recording session go in the end?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were awesome and got things done really quick, right?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, actually...
Some things happened and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, some things?
What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, the truth is...
Recording Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I did it again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seriously, Saki, you need to be careful not to rush ahead during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry!
But the thought of a bunch of people listening on the other side of that glass and how this is going to be released to the public is making me really nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I understand why you're nervous.
This isn't familiar territory for us. Honestly, I've been freezing up here and there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
I wish there were some way to help us relax.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Why don't you try taking some deep breaths, Saki? Gently exhale and inhale...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Breathe out... And in...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You still seem really anxious...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The next person to mess up owes me a bowl of ramen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
Only you stand to benefit from that, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, you'd also owe Ichika a yakisoba bun and Honami an apple pie. That'd be on top of my ramen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're assuming I'll be the one who messes up!
That's so mean!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
You're looking more like your usual self now, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's right.
You've gone from frowning to looking a little more relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... W-Wow, I think you're right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You should be able to play like normal now, so let's give it another try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I kept messing up when we first began recording...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we managed to nail it in the end!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you were able to get a good recording of it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, it's so strange...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Strange?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When we were first-years, after I'd just come back, I was so afraid that we wouldn't be friends anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But look at us now...
We actually managed to go pro together. Something about that feels so strange...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's all because you girls worked so hard to get here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What she said!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were able to get this far because you all worked super hard and never ran from your feelings!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you both...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we never would've been able to get this far without you guys! I mean, there were so many problems that we couldn't solve on our own...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Luka, Rin, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Sakki... That's so sweet of you...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't think we could've asked for more after watching over you girls like this. Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We also promise to keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As pros, we're gonna learn to perform a lot better, do lots and lots of shows...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And keep dashing forward into the future!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What was that just now...?
It sounded like a train stopping at a platform...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But it sounded kinda far away!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but nothing like this has ever happened before...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if something has changed about SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Changed how?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I can't say for certain.
So, why don't we all go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What is this place...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa!
I didn't know this part of SEKAI existed!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It looks like a station platform...
There's even a train stopped.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's so spacious...
But how did no one notice until now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought we'd explored every inch of this SEKAI already.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
...
This is just my guess...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I don't think it was always here.
This area may've newly appeared.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? A new area...?
Is that possible?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't say for sure since this is also completely new to me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But do you remember how this SEKAI was born out of you and the others' feelings, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
Our feelings coalesced and formed this SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Along those lines...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This place may be some kind of reflection of all of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
But it's difficult to say what those feelings entail.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try exploring this place a little more?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If we take a closer look, we might be able to find the answer☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
I also wanna see what this place has to offer!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Then, let's take a quick look, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go check out the platform on the other side since it also looks really big and spacious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, I'll try taking a look around the station. I'd like to get an idea of its overall scale.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Where do you wanna look, Sakki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, I'll keep checking this area out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna take a closer look at this train and these posters and bulletins and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Then, let us know if you find anything!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll see you two in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See you!

se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Line: Still, what's this station for...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, an electronic bulletin board!
It looks just like one you'd see on a real platform...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's no destination...?
Is it broken or something?

Hmm...
There's nothing written here either.

rows.Line:
(The doors don't seem to open...

rows.Line: Hello? I'd like to board!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, it's nice to meet you all! My name's Saki Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've actually been a student here since junior high school, but I ended up in the hospital for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now I'm back to perfect health, and ready to have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
My plan is to enjoy high school life to the fullest♪
Let's all be friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
Was that me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She just suddenly popped into my head and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye bye, Ichi! See you later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you later, Saki.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so sure that the four of us would start hanging out together again like old times...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I guess Ichi's right...
We're all busy high schoolers now, so things won't just go back to being the way they used to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, stop! I've gotta stay positive!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I keep making the effort to go talk to them, then we might be able to start hanging out again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll try again tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Hang on...
This is from when I got to start going to school again...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Does that mean I'm seeing my memories from back then...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why are they both being like that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's like they're avoiding me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(This is from...
Whenever I went over to talk to Shiho and Hona, they didn't really say anything to me.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They weren't acting like their usual selves, which bothered me a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm loving this! Everyone's parts are coming together in this song! Maybe we could start a band again, and things between us could be the way they used to be...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Hona, Ichi... Let's get the band back together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We met up in SEKAI, and I told them about how we should get our band back together.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Looking back, I was so desperate...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I wanted us to be friends again...
I thought getting our band back together was my only hope.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see now what we should do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should give up on getting her to join the band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That was really tough...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wanted Hona to be there with us, but I knew that she'd end up suffering as a result...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to tell her tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to let Hona know that she doesn't have to join our band.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to tell her, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If I tell her, I get the feeling this is how things are gonna be moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Just us. No Hona...
The four of us won't be friends again like we used to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't want that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't want to tell her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because it's in her best interest.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll get another chance to hang out again like we used to... Someday...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, for now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have to say goodbye to her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That was so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I mean, I really thought that we'd never see each other ever again.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We'd go our separate ways, graduate from high school, become adults and completely lose contact...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That scared me a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's okay, past me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We all get back together in the end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A lot of scary and not-so-nice things are gonna happen in the future...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But don't worry!
We managed to get through it all!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: Sakki! Sakki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Huh...? Am I...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We were so worried!
You didn't respond to anything we said! And then you started bawling your eyes out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What happened?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was just sort of dreaming for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Dreaming?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes. I don't know why, but I started seeing all these different things after touching this train...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like what happened before we got our band back together, when we weren't talking to each other...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Being reminded of what happened back then made me tear up a little...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't have to put on a brave face if it's too much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm not pretending to smile or anything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, being reminded of what happened was pretty tough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we're all back together now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've become pros and are moving forward together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes me super happy... So, it's all okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't know how our career as pros is going to unfold...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I know that the four of us will keep trying our best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll all do just fine as long as you stay together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Do your best, Sakki! We'll all be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, what made you see that dream...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I dunno...
It all happened so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if SEKAI wanted you to see what you just did?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
Your feelings may have affected it in such a way that it felt it needed to remind you of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If that's true, then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Maybe it was giving me an opportunity to tell my past self that everything is going to be okay...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, that reminds me...
Don't you have to be home soon?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She's right!
Isn't it almost time for you to have dinner?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you're right!
My mom's gonna be so worried!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll see you two later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go exploring again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I came here, since I got a chance to remember what happened back then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
